title: Tape break and return to Lester
summary: After a tape cut on November 10, Willard asks Lee to talk about how Lester evolved from the Minneapolis days.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Testing, testing. This is November the 10th?

I was speaking of the Cafe Society. I think that you wanted some input on what I thought about Lester from the time that I had seen him when we were quite young in Minneapolis, when Frankie Tromberg Trombanger was his idol, what changes he may havemade?
Yeah, well, how he evolved from that point.
